rows.text: In his farewell address to the nation dated 24.07.2017 President Pranab Mukherjee speaks on the eve of stepping down from office and welcomes Shri Ram Nath Kovind as the President-to-be.

bounded_scope: Head-of-state observations for CLAUDE-C01-15 only. The Election Commission's notices, the Returning Officer's declaration of the result and its Gazette publication, the programme for the ceremony of assumption of office, the oath administered by the Chief Justice, the Ministry of Home Affairs resolution and proclamation of the assumption of office, the holder's address on assumption, prospective term-expiry notices, farewells, stylings of a predecessor as former President and retrospective statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
